metadata.description: Onchain data infrastructure for finance, payments, and trading teams

plugins.name: goldsky
plugins.description: Index and stream onchain data for the questions finance teams actually ask: proof-of-reserves and circulating supply, stablecoin transfer and sanctions monitoring, deposit detection, cross-chain settlement tracking (CCTP), payment reconciliation, wallet balances and transaction history, tokenized assets and RWA holder registries, and prediction-market data including Polymarket fills, positions and PnL. Real-time pipelines, hosted subgraphs, and managed RPC across 150+ chains.
